ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*text\\\.encoding\\]\\:\\:ascii.*")) AND (Payload = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.compression\\\.deflatestream.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.streamreader.*")) AND Payload = RGX("readtoend$"))
